ART DECO
Exclusive decor inspired by the Chrysler Building in NYC.
The Chrysler Building looms tall and glamorous against the New York City skyline. Considered one of the
most famous relics of Art Deco style, the building fuses ornamental metalwork and symmetrical
geometric patterns into a stunning work of industrial art. Striking and modem and oozing with luxury, Art
Deco design still resonates today. Feast your eyes on impossibly arched floor lamps, shimmering crystal
chandeliers, and dashing liquor cabinets. Choose your favorites and infuse your own space with a bit of
glitzy Art Deco style.
